description.value: Otter Co-op is a locally-owned co-operative with locations across the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley, offering food, fuel, feed, pharmacy, and liquor services under one roof. As a member-owned business, it participates in community support programs and offers a member savings program. Touring cyclists will find it a useful multi-service stop, with the potential for groceries and fuel in one location.
